item: The intended use and users are stated, and so are the uses the model must not serve
The target is defined, with its time window and how outcomes were observed
The training data are described: period, rows, any sampling or rebalancing
Every feature is listed with when it is known; excluded attributes are listed with the reason
The training settings are enough to refit the model: recipe, seeds and library versions
Discrimination is measured on rows the shipped model never saw
Calibration is measured with a proper score and a reliability diagram
The uncertainty of predictions is stated (intervals or sets) with the coverage achieved
Results are given by subgroup, with intervals
The explanation method is stated and its stability across refits is checked
The inputs and outcomes to monitor are named, with thresholds and an owner
Conditions of use, known limits and the human review of decisions are stated
